scope: Resident native PFM reset, world bounds, brute-force pairs, contact plan and analytic ball/box manifolds
tolerance_reason: Base per-field f32 tolerances remain unchanged. Composed box-box coordinates and depths additionally allow 32 f32 epsilon times local geometry scale, with independent surface validation of both Rust and TileLang contacts. Normals, materials, counters, plans, IDs and guards retain their existing checks.
preconditions: Rust-derived buffer layouts, valid sizes and launch bounds
Contact capacity equals twice the global pair capacity
Ball/cuboid shapes only; valid parents agree with broad-phase filters; initial pair count is zero
Enough pair capacity for every candidate; no truncation and no host pair/manifold computation
invariants: All counters and indirect-grid dimensions match Rust exactly, including zero work and capacity clamping
Copied bits and unused capacity remain unchanged
Native pair order may vary but every pair is present exactly once; compare each manifold by its exact collider-pair identity
Five ordered stages share resident storage; the analytic grid-stride kernel consumes the published device plan with no host readback
outside_scope: Deferred PFM geometry, meshes, polylines and contact reduction
Full solver stepping, long-run stability, production backend integration
Ascend vendor compilation, execution, synchronization qualification and performance

box_geometry_roundoff.scale: max cuboid half-extent or relative translation component
box_geometry_roundoff.independent_check: Both endpoints lie on their respective box surfaces and the contact normal is unit length, in f64 validation of the f32 inputs.
